d: Short, messy honey-blonde hair with parted bangs frames a youthful, mature face with sharp, narrow light-blue eyes. The slim build is dressed in a black formal suit featuring a white dress shirt and tie, a black blazer with purple inner lining, and matching black trousers and polished black shoes. A long black coat with a purple interior flows behind, complemented by a large, pointed black shield with a central knot emblem and several thick black chains with spiked tips wrapping around the figure.
